extDesc.message: Cast this tab to a Chromecast / Google TV and control the TV. Companion of the Fling desktop app (Windows, Linux).

cmdCastTab.message: Cast this tab to the TV

offlineBody.message: This extension is the browser half of Fling. Start the Fling app on this computer (Start menu → Fling) and it connects automatically.

openVideoPage.message: Open a video page, then try again.

needCatt.message: Fling needs catt — see the Fling panel.

pairHint.message: Pair once with the TV to unlock apps, the d-pad, and typing.

scrollHint.message: or scroll here to move around the TV

optShareTabs.message: Tell the Fling app which tab is open

optShareTabsHint.message: Lets the panel's “Cast this tab” and the system-wide shortcut work with this browser. The address goes only to the Fling app on this computer (127.0.0.1), never to the internet. Private windows are never shared.

optPause.message: Pause the video here after casting

optPauseHint.message: So the sound doesn't play twice.

optPortHint.message: Change only if you changed “bridge_port” in fling.json.

optShortcut.message: The shortcut (default Alt+Shift+C) can be changed on the browser's extension shortcuts page.

credit.message: Fling was created by Damion Rashford and Tatiana · unofficial port

optNotify.message: Notify when the TV moves to another video or track

optNotifyHint.message: A Windows / desktop notification from the Fling app with the new title. Same switch as “Notify when the video changes” in the Fling panel.
